selection: Pre-existing K=1 physical canary, before inspecting its long response; no search.
contrast: D0 vs E removes all core-specific threshold, stochastic-afferent and local-weight physics together.
D: No lowered-threshold core; retains identical localized stochastic afferent patch and region-specific graph weights.
E: Original one-core canary physics; no kick, prescribed events, Z/M or slow I.
statistical_unit: One paired 10 s realization on one topology; events are not independent network replicates.
operational_burst: Non-overlapping 10 ms bins: >=1% distinct E cells globally or >=10% distinct E cells in fixed input patch; adjacent supra-threshold bins merged across <=100 ms gaps; report duration, do not equate with patient HFO.
sparse_definition: Descriptive E mean <1 Hz and mean distinct-E fraction per 10 ms <1%; report values and events separately.

removed.threshold_lowering: all E thresholds restored to background 18 mV
removed.stochastic_input: all cells receive exact expected tonic arrivals; local OU and Poisson support empty; global OU loading zero
removed.local_input_mean: E: max(0.95*nu+OU,0) rate driving Poisson arrivals; D0: nu deterministic expected arrivals; mean is not matched

retained: identical neuron positions, all connection partners and delays, global EE kernel angle/spreads, synaptic kinetics, initial voltage, other E/I weights, and outside-ROI tonic input; within-ROI mean and fluctuations intentionally change
pairing_boundary: Same seed and network topology. External streams intentionally differ because the entire stochastic patch is removed; not a pure threshold intervention.
source_candidate_role: Global topology provenance only; no core masks/thresholds/weight blocks active in D0
metadata_correction: The frozen D0 execution design phrase same tonic external mean applies only outside the reference ROI. E ROI has max(0.95*nu + OU,0) Poisson input; D0 ROI restores deterministic nu. Both local mean and fluctuations change. No trajectory was altered or rerun.
